def: to place; intransitively, to be placed

occurrences.text: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.
So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
